notes.title: Multi-language Support Added !!!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings players!
We want to let you know that we added Multi-language support for 13 different languages, specifically:[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*] Chinese Simplified
[*] Chinese Traditional
[*] French	
[*] German
[*] Greek			
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[*] Turkish
[/list][/h3]

[h2]If you notice any problems, make a thread on the official forums, and we will get back to you.
Happy Playing !![/h2]

notes.title: Cross-Platform Online Co-op Now Available !!!
notes.content:
[h3]We are happy to announce our Major Update v.0.2.0.0 !!!
We bring you Cross-Platform Online Co-Op!
Now you can play from Windows, Linux, and Mac (oSX) with your friends![/h3]

[h1]Major Update v 2.0.0.0 Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Online[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Cross Platform Online Mode Added you can now play with your friends from Windows, Linux, and Mac(Osx).
[/list][/h3]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Added 1 New World (Water World) with 5 new levels.
[/list][/h3]

[h2]Physics[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Changed how physics worked for gameplay.
[/list][/h3]

[h2]Music[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Added Main Theme Song
[*] Added The Floor is Lava Song.
[*] Added 5 another songs.
[/list][/h3]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Fixed All kinds of Bugs.
[/list][/h3]
